reason: A 3D character asset production plugin that generates, processes, animates, and exports models through four configurable provider APIs, with local asset management and mock fallback support.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 Meshy、混元 3D、Tripo3D 和 Rodin API，从文字或参考图生成并处理可导出的 3D 角色资产。
summaries.en: Generates, processes, animates, and exports 3D character assets from text or reference images using configurable Meshy, Hunyuan 3D, Tripo3D, and Rodin APIs.

capabilities: Generates 3D character assets from text, images, or multiple views
Stores, renames, scores, transforms, rigs, animates, and exports 3D assets
Can delete stored assets and related sidecar files
